title: Velocity of b after collision
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as √(2μgs).

title: Length of the rope
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as 4μs.

title: Work-energy for block b
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem to block b's slide, relating friction, distance s, and its post-collision kinetic energy.

title: Energy conservation for swing
description: Important: Uses conservation of mechanical energy for block a's swing to find its speed at the lowest point (v₀² = 2gL).

title: Collision momentum conservation
description: Important: Applies conservation of linear momentum to the elastic collision (m v₀ = m v_a + 3m v_b).

title: Collision energy conservation
description: Important: Applies conservation of kinetic energy for the elastic collision (½m v₀² = ½m v_a² + ½(3m) v_b²).

title: Correct mass ratio use
description: Important: Correctly incorporates the given mass relationship (m_b = 3 m_a) into all momentum and energy equations.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly signs the work done by friction (should be negative) in the work-energy equation for block b.

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error in solving the simultaneous momentum and energy equations for the elastic collision.
